plugins.name: last-mile
plugins.description: Kills the last 20% of an almost-finished project. Scans the repo for unfinished edges: TODO/FIXME/HACK markers, missing UI states, production basics (favicon, meta/OG, robots.txt, error boundaries), unhandled promises/exceptions, console.log debris, and placeholder text. Emits a prioritized punch list; then the agent fixes items in order, one commit each. Caveat: heuristics are per-language (js/ts/py/html) and will miss framework-specific checks (e.g. a Vue SSR 404 or a Rails concern); treat the list as a floor, not a certificate.
